Author deTraci Regula guides you on this tour which lasts approximately one hour. Bring a flashlight and be prepared to walk over some uneven ground and go up and down stairs. \(Alternative accessible tour available on request.\)

item.title: Magdalena Open House: Walk Through a New Home You Can Lease and Buy — Thu Oct 29, 5:30 PM — Magdalena Home
item.description:

Magdalena homes sit on wheels, so they can be towed to a backyard, family land or your own lot. Lease one for $980 a month plus site fee, live in it first, and buy it later at a locked price of $68,000 if it's right for you.
The open house is for reservation holders. Reserve a spot for $100, refundable anytime, at magdalena.one and we'll send you the address.
